desc: Implement telescoped O(n^2) DP: prefNums/prefCost 1-indexed, dp[0]=0, dp[i]=min_{j<i} dp[j]+P[i]*(C[i]-C[j])+k*(C[n]-C[j]), answer dp[n] within class Solution.
Confirm the telescoping identity: each subarray charged k*(C[n]-C[start]), removing the order dimension from the DP.
Verify provided example 1 (expect 110) via hand computation; DP gives dp[3]=110.
Confirm O(n^2) complexity is within limits for n<=1000 and values fit Python big ints.
